biggest_catch: Official usercrowd.com states concrete per-minute rates ($0.20/min tests, $0.75/min+ interviews) but no official page states when or how testers actually receive their money.
catches: No official page states a payout schedule, payout threshold, or withdrawal timing — third parties cite a $10 minimum and ~14-30 day PayPal payments, none of it official.
Tests are short (avg 1-5 min at $0.20/min = $0.20-$1.00 per test), so reaching any threshold takes many tests.
Test availability is first-come-first-served and sporadic; some testers wait weeks for invites.
Tester answers are reviewed and can be rejected, forfeiting the reward.

c1.evidence: UserCrowd is a real research panel; official homepage with tester FAQ loaded live at usercrowd.com.

c2.evidence: Official FAQ: 'For tests, you'll get US$0.20 per minute. For interviews, you'll get US$0.75 per minute or more, depending on the duration.' Average test 1-5 min; interviews 15 min-2h (official interview table: $30 for 15 min up to $82.50 for 120 min) via help.usercrowd.com.

c3.evidence: Free to apply; official FAQ: 'Do I have to pay to apply? No.'

c4.evidence: No official UserCrowd page states payout timing/schedule. Official interview FAQ says incentives are credited to the UserCrowd balance after the session and payouts go via PayPal — but when the money reaches the tester is unstated.

eligibility: 18+, computer or mobile with internet, SMS-verified account, PayPal account; desktop/laptop/tablet/smartphone.
notes: Checked 2026-09-23. Per hard rule: reject. Payout rates are officially published ($0.20/min tests; $0.75/min+ interviews with a fixed incentive table), but no official page gives a payout schedule or timing — 'would I tell a friend this pays within days?' cannot be answered from official terms. Revisit if UserCrowd publishes official payout-timing terms. official per-minute rates confirmed; payout timing not stated officially — reject
